fn idle() ->
    recv
        _msg -> idle()

fn reg(pid, name) ->
    register(name, pid)
    pid

sup = Supervisor.start({ strategy: :one_for_one, max_restarts: 3, within: 5000, children: [{ name: :w, start: () -> reg(spawn_linked(() -> idle()), :w), restart: :permanent }, { name: :nested, start: () -> Supervisor.start({ strategy: :one_for_one, max_restarts: 1, within: 5000, children: [{ name: :inner, start: () -> reg(spawn_linked(() -> idle()), :inner), restart: :transient }] }), restart: :permanent }] })
root = spawn(() -> idle())
register(:root, root)
tree()
Repl.tree()
-- output --
sup = #<pid 1>
root = #<pid 5>
Ok(())
#<pid 0> name=None status=:running mailbox=0
#<pid 1> name=None status=:recv mailbox=0
  #<pid 2> name=Some(:w) status=:recv mailbox=0
  #<pid 3> name=None status=:recv mailbox=0
    #<pid 4> name=Some(:inner) status=:recv mailbox=0
#<pid 5> name=Some(:root) status=:recv mailbox=0
#<pid 0> name=None status=:running mailbox=0
#<pid 1> name=None status=:recv mailbox=0
  #<pid 2> name=Some(:w) status=:recv mailbox=0
  #<pid 3> name=None status=:recv mailbox=0
    #<pid 4> name=Some(:inner) status=:recv mailbox=0
#<pid 5> name=Some(:root) status=:recv mailbox=0
